description:
ENDURANCE Industrial LED High Bay | 140 lm/W | IP65

The ENDURANCE Industrial LED High Bay is a professional solution for high-performance industrial lighting, designed for factories, warehouses, workshops and large indoor spaces. Its power is selectable via DIP Switch between 100W, 150W and 200W, allowing you to adapt consumption and light output to each installation.

It features an OSRAM DURIS E 2835 LED and a DOB Linear NO FLICK driver, delivering stable, flicker-free lighting with a high efficiency of up to 140 lm/W. Its 120° beam angle provides a wide, uniform light distribution.

Rugged construction for industrial environments

Made of ALU + glass, it combines excellent mechanical strength with good heat dissipation to extend the lifespan of the LED components. Its IP65 protection makes it resistant to dust and water, suitable for demanding industrial environments.

It also includes Surge 1kV/2kV overvoltage protection, improving the safety and reliability of the installation.

Technical specifications

  • Selectable power: 100W / 150W / 200W
  • LED: OSRAM DURIS E 2835
  • Efficiency: up to 140 lm/W
  • Beam angle: 120°
  • Driver: DOB Linear NO FLICK
  • Material: Aluminium + glass
  • Protection: IP65
  • Surge protection: 1kV/2kV
  • Power adjustment: DIP Switch

Recommended applications

Ideal for factories, warehouses, workshops, industrial buildings, logistics centres and other high-ceiling spaces that require powerful, uniform and efficient lighting.

The ENDURANCE combines OSRAM technology, selectable power, 140 lm/W and IP65 in an LED high bay designed to deliver high performance and a long service life in industrial installations.
